title: fix(ci): bump libuv-sys-lite to 1.48.4, pin rolldown minifier to 1.2.7
body:
Fixes the two independent breakages currently keeping main's CI red; they
have to land together for a green run.

First, the windows-11-arm64 runner image update (20260830.155 ->
20260906.161, rolled out starting Sep 8) bumped LLVM 20.1.6 to 22.1.8.
libuv-sys-lite 1.48.3 has no pregenerated bindings for windows-aarch64, so
it runs bindgen at build time there, and bindgen 0.70.1 (via clang-sys
1.8.1, which predates LLVM 22) silently generates unusable bindings against
the new libclang: opaque size-1 structs and missing
`sockaddr_in`/`sockaddr_in6`. Any cold build of the crate on those runners
fails, which is why the windows-aarch64 integration jobs (building
test_napi) went red - intermittently during the image rollout, consistently
since. Bump to libuv-sys-lite 1.48.4, which ships pregenerated
windows-aarch64 bindings (nathanwhit/libuv-sys-lite#5), so bindgen no
longer runs on CI at all - matching how the crate already works on every
other platform.

Second, the release snapshot minifier runs `npm:rolldown/experimental`
unpinned, and rolldown 1.2.8 (published Sep 9) started mangling private
class members with no opt-out, turning stack frames like
`Worker.#pollControl` into `Worker.#s` and breaking 12 worker spec tests in
the `test specs release` jobs. Pin the minifier to 1.2.7 (same commit as
#36844; whichever lands first dedupes).

Closes #36836
